_readme: Blast and rule constants of the current build (engine block 'levels6 v10' + charges/bonds literals in index.html).

Charges: imp = specific impulse (N*s per m2 of exposed area) at the charge, falling off as (1 - d/R)^2 with distance d to the nearest point of a body, R = radius (m). Game damage to a member = dmg x (1 - d/R)^1.1 x member.dmg (armor applied inside damage()); d = distance from the charge to the member's nearest point; dmg, imp and R are multiplied by the Upgrades power multipliers (powerMul) unless noUpg. Protected members never take charge damage directly (only from debris/physics). See function blast() in index.html. Only TNT is used on L1-36 (tntOnly: every level's charges become TNT).
Bonds: joint capacities per 0.384 m2 of contact (t tension N, s shear N, m bending N*m, c crushing N); a 6-DOF spring joint breaks when its measured force exceeds the capacity (PHYSICS-AUDIT.md).

Rules are fixed for every level (D-blast-THRESH / THRESH-2): PASS 85% of the target mass demolished; protected buildings max 5% damage. The street rule (rubble on the road) is OFF in the default build since D-blast-TAP2 (?tap2=0 restores it). Unlimited blasts (waves) while TNT lasts. Props (trees, cars, crates) are not counted (D-blast-PROPS).

physics.step: fixed 1/60 s with accumulator; slow-mo and hit-stop only change how fast real time feeds it
physics.deterministic: same plan = same result (RUNBOOK R-11 procedure, determinism-check.js)
